title: Netanyahu’s Iran war press briefing targeted at ‘audience of one’: Donald Trump
summary: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu’s press briefing Thursday on the Iran war was targeted at an “audience of one”, says FRANCE 24’s Noga Tarnopolsky, reporting from Jerusalem, noting that his message was directed at President Donald Trump.
